name: Auralise
description: Auralise the room scene by convolving the impulse responses with the source signals. The signals keep the format of their impulse responses: mono (Simulate Pyroomacoustics), binaural or ambisonic (Simulate Hybrid).

inputParameters.name: anechoic_sounds
inputParameters.description: Optional anechoic sound file(s), one per impulse response, paired by position in matching branches. If not provided, each impulse response uses the sound file of its Source.

inputParameters.name: level
inputParameters.description: Output level: 'relative' (default) applies one gain to all signals of this run so the loudest peaks at -1 dBFS, keeping distance and level differences; 'individual' brings each signal to -1 dBFS; 'none' keeps the raw level and may clip.

inputParameters.name: mix_sources
inputParameters.description: If True, sum all sources heard at the same receiver into one signal per receiver (the full scene); their impulse responses must share one format. If False (default), output one signal per source and receiver.

inputParameters.name: save_file_path
inputParameters.description: File path to save the convolved signal(s). Default is the current working directory.

inputParameters.name: save_file_name
inputParameters.description: File name for the saved convolved signal(s). Default is 'convolved_sound'.

inputParameters.name: save
inputParameters.description: Whether to save the convolved signal(s) to a file, in their format: 1 channel (mono), 2 (binaural) or (order + 1)^2 (ambisonic, ACN/SN3D).

outputParameters.name: signals
outputParameters.description: Auralised signal(s) in the format of their impulse responses, shaped (samples, channels). The Audio Player plays mono (on both channels) and binaural; ambisonic signals are for saving.

outputParameters.name: sampling_rate
outputParameters.description: Sample rate of each auralised signal, in Hz.
